title: Dad's Tomato Sauce (Small Batch)
description: A smaller version of Dad’s sauce with a softened vegetable base, blended tomatoes and Parmesan, a stovetop simmer, and a short oven reduction.
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste (the notebook does not state its size; a 6 oz can is about 170 g)
50 g Parmesan cheese, divided; 25 g specified for blending
Salt, pepper, basil, oregano, crushed red pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning blend, to taste
steps: Roughly chop the onion, celery, and carrot and heat the olive oil in an oven safe pot.
Sauté the vegetables, except the garlic, until soft. Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and sauté for 2–3 minutes, then add the crushed tomatoes.
Salt the mixture and blend with a stick blender. Add 25 g Parmesan and blend again.
Add the bay leaf and simmer for about 1 hour. Season, taste, and adjust the salt, spices, and herbs.
Preheat the oven to 275°F / 135°C and simmer the sauce for about 30 minutes more.
Add the red wine and remaining 25 g Parmesan if using the suggested placement described in the notes. Transfer the pot to the oven and reduce slightly. Remove the bay leaf and serve.
notes: Transcribed from Dad's separate small batch page. The page lists 50 mL red wine and 50 g Parmesan but only explicitly places 25 g Parmesan during blending and gives no step for the wine. Adding the wine and remaining Parmesan before the oven is an editorial suggestion, not a documented step. The can size is also unstated; 170 g is an example for a 6 oz can. Seasonings are to taste.
